findings.title: Artifact existence is accepted as evidence authority
findings.repair: One evidence resolver (localflow/v2/curation/evidence.py qualify): exists, unpurged, owned by the example row's job or the task, producer role for the slot, payload retained, digest match; used by the ASR gate, export views, readiness, mining/teach attribution and the profile speech read.

findings.title: Exporter recursively removes an unowned staging directory
findings.repair: Each build creates its own .<name>.building-<export_id> exclusively with an ownership file and removes only that folder.

findings.title: Your Voice can publish speech after its source artifact was purged
findings.repair: Profile commit re-checks each example's exact raw artifact and revision; a purged support invalidates snapshots as source_purged.

findings.title: A new export can reclaim frozen-test status from an older assignment
findings.repair: A new export joins its families to exposure across every assignment version and refuses an exposed family still in frozen_test.

findings.title: Audio export trusts an unconstrained stored source path
findings.repair: Audio is admitted only as one plain managed name and streamed through open_managed_file (no-follow, regular files only).

findings.title: Export publication is outside the final source-liveness fence
findings.repair: Publication is one writer op that re-checks consent and every dependency, inserts the complete row and renames staging into place.

findings.title: Portable export cannot independently reconstruct or qualify its full evidence graph
findings.repair: Per-record lineage (export schema 2) and a semantic validator that rejects checksum-consistent semantic tampering and reconstructs task inputs from the package alone.

findings.title: Preference selection ignores the liveness of its source task
findings.repair: evidence.preference_pair_in: same task and conditional hashes, source and outputs retained with producer roles, source equal to the task's recorded input; shared by export and readiness.

findings.title: Approval can install a rule after its candidate was revoked
findings.repair: Approval is one writer op: evidence re-check, plan, M05 mutation through composable VocabularyStore operations and the approved mark.

findings.title: Undo is not confined to the original vocabulary delta
findings.repair: The exact delta is recorded in learning_vocabulary_deltas (schema v13); undo reverses only it and refuses user_modified_since_approval.

findings.title: Teach does not bind to the immutable final text the reviewer saw
findings.repair: teach_correction takes the rendered final artifact id and sha256 in one writer op, refuses stale_final and never substitutes raw; History Teach passes the rendered identity.

findings.title: Confirmed graft offsets are not bound to the displayed source identity
findings.repair: record_label takes the expected source artifact id and sha256; spans are strict integer code-point offsets; the graft records its source identity.

findings.title: Note mining combines dictated and typed regions under one job
findings.repair: Per-region attribution with M12 rebase ambiguity; typed and straddling regions are excluded; two jobs mint nothing.

findings.title: Readiness and export disagree on task eligibility
findings.repair: Readiness task eligibility calls the export's own predicates (task_eligibility_revision m14-policy-r1).

findings.title: Counterexample transcripts are stored in long-lived candidate metadata
findings.repair: Phrases and flips live in a lease-governed counterexample_result artifact; the candidate row keeps a content-free result.

findings.title: The A/B pane does not establish what the user is judging
findings.repair: The pair pane renders the source and both candidate texts with ids and display order; the judgment records exactly the rendered pair and slot order.

findings.title: M14 retry-sensitive actions lack end-to-end operation identity
findings.repair: m14_operation_receipts (schema v13); services accept operation_id; the Hub keeps the id across an unknown outcome and reconciles on retry.

findings.title: Job-only teaches appear in Review but cannot be selected for action
findings.repair: A candidate chooser popup binds Approve/Reject to the rendered row's candidate id, including job-only teaches.

findings.title: A historical non-abstained label can hide a currently unresolved item
findings.repair: One effective-judgment reducer (review.effective_judgment_in) for the queue, gate, readiness and Your Voice.

findings.title: Teach rejects punctuation-only corrections before classification
findings.repair: A punctuation or structure change is recorded as a review record with its format regions and no alias.

findings.title: Near-spelling semantic opposites can be suggested as recognition corrections
findings.repair: classify.is_direction_flip: opposite-direction word pairs are ambiguous (direction_flip_needs_review) with no alias.

findings.title: Approval composition compares raw rather than canonical scopes
findings.repair: Plans use M05 identity via VocabularyStore.find_in (NOCASE canonical, canonical scope value).

findings.title: A second profile signature can suppress a needed vocabulary refresh
findings.repair: The evidence signature includes vocabulary entry revisions; the fast input signature is remembered only when the recomputed evidence signature is equal.

findings.title: Unpin can revoke M14 review-retention leases
findings.repair: One REVIEW_RETENTION_ROLES constant: pin never leases and unpin never revokes review payloads; machine suggestions keep finite leases.

findings.title: A supplied --db argument breaks the export CLI
findings.repair: scripts/v2/export_dataset.py parses --db as a path.

findings.title: Historical M14 evidence still contains absolute private paths
findings.repair: Forward redaction: current M14 evidence and every new run record carry repository-relative placeholders; committed history is not rewritten (a rewrite needs the owner's explicit authorization).

findings.title: Important negative suites lack independent end-to-end semantic oracles
findings.repair: Fail-first regressions with independent oracles and the frozen-corpus drivers (m14_drivers_a..h); the base passes the f27 oracle, so the gap was coverage, not behavior.

findings.title: M14 benchmark reports lack independent work-validity and current-tree measurements
findings.repair: benchmark_m14 recounts every component's work before timing; each no-op component makes the run INVALID; environment and tree state recorded.

findings.title: Repository-wide caller and native qualification remain unproven
findings.repair: caller_inventory.json covers every tracked caller; the owned-window Hub suite qualifies the native actions. Real-use manual checks remain pending for the owner.

findings.title: Historical blocking labels conflict with while-unresolved semantics
findings.repair: ambiguous/user_rewrite block until an explicit non-blocking effective judgment; changed_intent stays permanent.

findings.title: Task-keyed transform and preference rows are outside family partitions
findings.repair: Task rows export as unpartitioned with holdout_qualified false, only when train is requested; otherwise excluded as task_keyed_unpartitioned.

findings.title: Cleanup records with missing exact model inputs are still named supervised
findings.repair: Cleanup records carry qualification_tier model_task_complete or text_pair_only; manifest, README and readiness count the tiers.

findings.title: Technical-term statistics are not exclusively retained-speech evidence
findings.repair: technical_terms come from rules applied in eligible dictations with citing examples; dictionary counters are labeled as such.

findings.title: Rejection identity needs an explicit canonical/scope policy
findings.repair: Suppression key (alias lower-cased, canonical under M05 ASCII case identity), global across scopes.

findings.title: An empty counterexample set must not imply safety qualification
findings.repair: No phrases is recorded untested; phrases are checked over the effective post-approval dictionary in the rule's scope.

findings.title: Single-candidate acceptance history needs an effective-target policy
findings.repair: The latest accept/reject decides a transform target; automatic application alone never does.

local_findings.title: Hub Review, History and Export controls overlap or clip in the owned window
local_findings.repair: Non-overlapping control frames; export view checkboxes wrap three per row (localflow/v2/ui/hub.py).

local_findings.title: A late Export-tab refresh can repaint over a just-shown Validate result
local_findings.repair: None. Observation only: the result is written and the next action shows it; the native check drains pending refreshes before reading. Recorded for the owner's manual Hub pass.

local_findings.title: The ASR gate admits audio whose managed file vanished, and the export then refuses the whole build
local_findings.repair: qualify checks the payload file is present as a regular managed file when given the artifact directory; the gate, readiness and export pass it.

local_findings.title: An audio artifact id names the exported file unchecked, so a traversal id writes outside the dataset
local_findings.repair: The audio slot requires the artifact id to be a plain managed name.

local_findings.title: validate_dataset raises on wrongly typed record fields
local_findings.introduced_by: first-pass remediation 4b9de5c (the semantic validator is new; the audited base has none)
local_findings.repair: A wrong JSON type is reported as an issue, never raised.

local_findings.title: validate_dataset hashes a listed file through a symlinked directory
local_findings.repair: No listed or audio path passing through a symlinked directory is opened.

local_findings.title: A non-numeric recorded UTC offset stops profile computation
local_findings.repair: A corrupt or impossible offset (outside UTC-12..UTC+14) counts in hours_unknown.

independent_review.reviewer: fresh-context agent in a detached read-only worktree at the frozen SHA; given the audit, decisions, contracts and code, not the author's adjudications
independent_review.reproduction: every allegation was reproduced by the author with its own fail-first regression (tests/v2/personalization/test_m14_remediation.py, REVIEW-IR-*) before any repair

findings.title: Re-approval after undo installed the alias on the earlier entry even after it was renamed or a different scope was chosen
findings.repair: _plan_in always plans by find_in on the candidate's canonical and requested scope; an earlier entry is reused only while it holds that identity

findings.title: A rejected pair stayed approvable through a sibling candidate
findings.repair: reject suppresses pending siblings with the same D05 key; approve refuses pair_rejected

findings.title: Counterexample phrases from earlier attempts survived note deletion
findings.repair: each attempt purges the previous counterexample_result

findings.title: A timeout at the export publication op reported failed while the export committed complete
findings.repair: the timeout is raised as an unknown outcome with no abort and no failed row; the export id's receipt reconciles

findings.title: An operation id reused on another target returned a false success
findings.repair: receipt_in compares the recorded target

findings.title: Undo after delete-everywhere returned the deleted job's candidate to pending with its terms
findings.repair: undo leaves a candidate whose evidence died stale with terms cleared

findings.title: The validator did not bind the cleanup input and reference, the preference input, the record partition or the graft text to lineage
findings.repair: each is checked against its lineage digest; graft references carry graft_record

findings.title: The validator raised on deep nesting and unreadable files
findings.repair: RecursionError and OSError are reported as issues

findings.title: Exposure recorded between snapshot and fence was not re-checked
findings.repair: the fence refuses when a family exported as unexposed has been exposed

findings.title: A live example outside the assignment version was silently omitted while readiness counted it
findings.repair: reason-coded as not_in_assignment_version

findings.title: An unknown partition name produced an empty complete export
findings.repair: build refuses unknown partitions

findings.title: A purged rendered final refused with no_retained_final_text instead of stale_final
findings.repair: a supplied expected final that no longer qualifies refuses as stale_final

findings.title: A teach's never-expiring payload lease pinned its example against the 30-day buffer (predates the remediation; conflicts with D08)
findings.repair: prune_training leaves review roles out of its pin test; a pending explicit teach still holds its example (D08 clarification)

findings.title: The Hub could not record an abstention: its 'unknown' label resolved an ambiguous blocker (reviewer's policy suspicion)
findings.repair: the Hub records edit kind 'unknown' as an abstention (D01 clarification)

unreproduced_or_not_filed.note: A sampled example labeled then abstained leaves the queue (annotated state); the queue definition makes this arguable — not changed.
A graft row exports from the latest graft label even after a later changed_intent or abstained revision; no contract bars it — not changed.
A commit failure after os.rename inside publish_op, and a leftover .replaced-<id> after destination_appeared, need injected SQLite failures — not reproduced.
voiceExcludeEvidence_ resolves profile.current() at click time; exclusion is durable by example id, worst case a spurious not_evidence refusal — not pursued.
Sentence-casing teaches (how->How) suggest a casing rule; predates the remediation, no decision covers it.
The Hub has no Undo-approval control (absent at base too); hub.md no longer lists Undo among its operation-id actions.

observations.note: For 'foo foo foo' -> 'foo fob foo' difflib reads an insertion plus a deletion of the third copy; the record is abstained with no alias and nothing is attributed to the first copy, so the predicate holds; its offsets name an untouched copy.

record_pair_judgment accepts a same-task-key pair whose candidate rows were forged by SQL to carry different source or instruction digests or wrong artifact roles; no producer writes such rows, and the export's preference predicate refuses them.

A process killed after the publication rename and before the op commits leaves a complete, checksum-valid dataset with no completion row; the next build to that destination recognizes it as an earlier LocalFlow export.
The synthetic database is already at the current schema, so the migration-backup half of the CLI case was not exercised.
The package carries no referenced rights object (consent travels as consent_revision_id and allowed_uses text), so the rights variant could not be constructed.
No standalone validator distribution is declared; the case was bound to a copy of the localflow package and the script outside the checkout.
